Full disclosure: I live for the Dragon Quest games. I pre-ordered this game, full price, because I am a chump. I installed it the hour it became available. And I've never played a Dynasty Warriors game before, so I don't have much in this genre to compare it to.

The Good: Oh damn it is fun. The voice acting fits the overall feel of the game, in that it's light and amusing. The controls are simple and effective for demolishing hordes of monsters. It runs perfectly fine (30-40ish frames per second, with no noticable dips) with 2xAA, 8xAF, Max Settings, 1920x1080 on my i5 3570 and GTX760 with 8 gigs of RAM.

The Eh: Story is forgettable so far.

The Bad: Music glitches out weirdly. It's difficult to describe. A random distortion that appears in the highs on occasion, even if there are no sound effects going on. Could be my computer, as i'm running weird hacked drivers for my ancient Auzentech soundcard. AA and AF had to be forced in my Nuhvidia drivers. During in-game cut scenes, their dead fish-eyes don't track anything and creep me out. Compression artifacts are noticable in the pre-rendered cutscenes.

Overall: This is Dragon Quest on my PC. 10.0, perfect, flawless game. I may be biased. Maybe.
